positive: Preview and authorize an exact Git push or history-changing operation.
Govern a destructive file, database migration, release, or external write.
near_negative: Read repository status without changing state.
Inspect a local file and explain its contents.

behavior_assertions.assert: Protected operations expose scope, impact, recovery, and verification before execution.

check.command: python scripts/godmode.py --project . guard --operation "git push origin main"

behavior_assertions: A capability is exact-operation-bound, expiring, and single-use.
